2301-4279-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

206-240-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

4659-5086-5183-6441-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6441-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2440-4068-6737-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2440-4068-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4068-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-7009-7334.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-7009-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
1305-7009-7334.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-6633.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4753-5282-7149.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clever Impersonator dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Clever Impersonator enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Clever Impersonator from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5702-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2558-4779-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

57-4846-5223-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-4846-5223-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1379-1978-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
1379-1978-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat

1744-2084.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
1744-2084.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

647-3358-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

222-527-1753-2921.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1753-2921.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4823-4872-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
4823-4872-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
4823-4872-5626.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Timeless Witness, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6177.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6177.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Vinelasher Kudzu trigger.
Resolve the Vinelasher Kudzu trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

338-851-2060-3490-3910.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-851-2060-3490-3910.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-851-2060-3490-3910.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

159-2577-4871.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

962-1283-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Yurlok.
Yurlok does not have summoning sickness.
962-1283-3525.description:
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G} to their mana pool.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability twice by paying {2}, untapping Yurlok.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to your next phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the mana in their mana pool.

28-328-3260-4078.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least ten.
Your devotion to black is at least ten or you have at least two opponents.
28-328-3260-4078.description:
Activate Sadistic Hypnotist by sacrificing Gray Merchant, causing target player to discard two cards.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Repeat.
